notes: Affinities are modeled in two levels. A magic family (e.g. water) contains specializations (e.g. water.rain, water.mist). Each resonant grants three specializations; 'families' is derived from them. A game can grant a whole family or a single specialization. Specialization ids are '<familyId>.<slug>'. Resonant ids are wheel-prefixed (emo./phy.) because some names appear on both wheels. 'path' lists ancestors so a game can choose whether affinities inherit. Opposition is defined between roots.

layout.center: Roots form the innermost ring; each depth outward is one ring further out.
layout.rootOrder: Roots are placed clockwise by wheels[].roots[].position, starting at 12 o'clock, so each root sits directly across from its oppositeId.
layout.rootAngle: Every root receives an equal share of the circle (360 / root count), regardless of how many resonants it contains.
layout.leafAngle: Within a root, every leaf (a resonant with no children) receives an equal share of that root's angle. A branch's angle is the sum of its leaves' angles.
layout.childOrder: Children are drawn clockwise in childIds order.
layout.rotationOffset: The full wheel is rotated back by half a root slice so that root 0 is centered at 12 o'clock.
layout.ringRadii: Rings may be equal width; the reference page uses inner radius ~12% and outer radius 100% of the drawing radius, split evenly by maximum depth.

color.rule: Fill comes from the resonant's tone; the shade index is its depth (0 = root, the strongest shade), capped at the last shade.
color.textRule: Root labels use text.root color; deeper labels use the tone's text color for the current theme.

labels.rule: Labels are drawn radially, centered in their segment, and flipped 180 degrees on the left half so they read upright. A label is shown only when its segment's arc length at mid-radius exceeds about 13 units on a 690-unit drawing; otherwise it is left for hover or zoom.
